title: Partition-Based Functional Ridge Regression for High-Dimensional Data
summary: This paper proposes a partition-based functional ridge regression framework to address multicollinearity, overfitting, and interpretability in high-dimensional functional linear models. The coefficient function vector \( \boldsymbolβ(s) \) is decomposed into two components, \( \boldsymbolβ_1(s) \) and \( \boldsymbolβ_2(s) \), representing dominant and weaker functional effects. This partition enables differential ridge penalization across functional blocks, so that important signals are preserved while less informative components are more strongly shrunk.
